Gravity Runner v0.1 Itch Browser Build
This is the itch.io browser version.
This build has no ads and no in-app purchases.
Upload gravity-runner-itch-v0.1.zip to itch.io as an HTML5 browser game.
index.html must be at the ZIP root.
Recommended itch setting: Click to launch fullscreen.
Android monetization builds are handled separately.
